name: Borrowed Time
permit: Free self-issue Henry M. Jackson Wilderness permit or trailhead registration; no quota or fee. Northwest Forest Pass at developed trailheads.

road.name: Forest Road 4096 (Bedal Creek Rd) off the Mountain Loop Highway
road.status: Unpaved and rough, with deep unavoidable potholes especially in the upper half; high-clearance 4WD/AWD recommended
road.driveNote: From Darrington drive about 17.5-18.25 miles south on the Mountain Loop Highway and turn onto FR 4096; climbs steeply about 2-3 miles to the trailhead near 2,800 ft — winter access will likely require additional snow travel/skinning from lower on the road.
